description: neuralese-direct-mellum-v4 resumed from the qualified direct_warmup of the neuralese-direct-mellum-v3 lineage (runs/neuralese-direct-mellum-20261011/run-v3/direct_warmup: 333 updates, 0.5 epoch of the 4962-document full-prompt Mellum twin, held CE 2.219 -> 0.438, identity check passed), so the warm-up is not redone (coordinator decision 2026-10-12). First difference from the parity recipe neuralese-direct-mellum-v4: its direct_warmup stage is replaced by that finished warm-up, bound as direct_sft's declared continuation inputs (full state, identity check, base drift reference; content-pinned), so the warm-up saw the 4962 documents rather than the r2 union's full-prompt rendering. Second difference (owner decision 2026-10-12, "continue our training from what we have with more data"): direct_sft continues on union r3's program-header rendering by a data continuation (continued_text_data = the r2 program-header file it trained on): update counter, weights, MuonSR and QAT state continue; the r2 documents of its consumed updates count as seen and the rest of its 1 epoch is r3 minus them; the QAT progress [0, 0.35] continues from its value at the continuation update over the new total; held windows come from r3's test split, with the base re-measured on the stage's update-0 weights (direct_sft.py data_continuation). Third difference (coordinator decision 2026-10-12): direct_trajectory (1 epoch) reads union r3's whole-trajectory Mellum rendering (runs/natlang-target-union-20261011-r3, natlang-target-set-20261011-r3: 165,822 train / 1,549 test documents, 50.2M supervised tokens) instead of r2's (75,983 / 123, 15.9M); its held/test split is the r3 file's own test split (a superset of r2's 123 test documents), evaluation unchanged. Both are taken by one --handoff while direct_sft runs (recipe.py unstarted_stage_input_changes). Fourth difference (owner decision 2026-10-12, REVIEW_20261012 rec. 4): an objective continuation of the active direct_sft (objective_continuation, pinning the quantization component it trained with): the curriculum moves to the shared base's (direct_sft [0, 0.75], direct_trajectory [0.75, 1.0]) from its value at the handoff update, and the nested family (28x32, 28x16, 21x32) joins as an objective, ramped in from zero.

objective_continuation.description: Owner decision 2026-10-12 (REVIEW_20261012 rec. 4): the running direct_sft takes the shared curriculum (direct_sft [0, 0.75], direct_trajectory [0.75, 1.0]) and the nested-family objective at its next --handoff. Pinned: the quantization component it trained with (canonical sha256; curriculum direct_sft [0, 0.35], direct_trajectory [0.35, 0.5]) and no family. The trainer continues the curriculum from its value at the handoff update to 0.75 over the remaining updates (as the data continuation did) and refuses any lambda or member-weight jump (direct_sft.objective_continuation); weights, MuonSR state, update counter and data plan continue.
